Finance Manager
A mid-size manufacturing group is hiring a Finance Manager for its Mumbai head office.

Responsibilities:
- Monthly and annual closing across group entities
- GST and TDS compliance, statutory audits
- Financial reporting under Ind AS / IFRS

Requirements:
- 6+ years in accounting or finance
- Must have hands-on GST compliance experience
- Must have worked on Tally or SAP
- Chartered Accountant preferred
- Advanced Excel

Location: Mumbai (office-based).

requirements.title: Finance Manager
requirements.summary: Finance manager handling closing, GST/TDS compliance and IFRS reporting in Mumbai.
